schemes.name: Micro Finance Scheme
schemes.text: Micro Finance Scheme: For small units with a project cost up to Rs 1.40 lakh. The funding agency provides up to 90% of project cost (maximum Rs 1.25 lakh) as a concessional loan at 6.5% per annum. Repayment over 3 years including a 3-month moratorium on principal. Beneficiary must contribute 10% margin money. Eligible activities include tiny trades, services, and small manufacturing for income generation by marginalized communities.

schemes.name: Term Loan Scheme
schemes.text: Term Loan Scheme: For projects costing between Rs 1.40 lakh and Rs 50.00 lakh. The agency provides up to 90% of project cost (maximum Rs 45 lakh) at 8% per annum. Repayment over 7 years including a 6-month moratorium on principal. Beneficiary contributes 10% margin money. Eligible activities include agriculture-allied, industrial, service, and transport sector income-generating projects.

schemes.name: Mahila Samriddhi Yojana
schemes.text: Mahila Samriddhi Yojana: For women beneficiaries of backward classes. Project cost up to Rs 1.40 lakh. Loan up to 90% at 4% per annum (concessional rate for women). Repayment up to 3 years with moratorium as applicable. Requires training certificate or skill evidence in some states.

schemes.name: New Swarnima Scheme for Women
schemes.text: New Swarnima Scheme: For women beneficiaries of backward classes. Project cost up to Rs 2.00 lakh. Loan up to 90% of project cost at 5% per annum. Repayment up to 5 years. No collateral; group guarantee through SHGs may be used.

schemes.name: PMEGP (Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme)
schemes.text: PMEGP: Credit-linked subsidy scheme for micro-enterprises. Project cost up to Rs 50 lakh (manufacturing) / Rs 20 lakh (service). Margin money 15-25% depending on category (urban/rural, general/special). Subsidy 15-35% of project cost. Loan from banks at normal rates. Implemented via KVIC, KVIB, DIC.

schemes.name: PM SVANidhi
schemes.text: PM SVANidhi: Working capital micro-credit for street vendors. Collateral-free loans of Rs 10,000 / Rs 20,000 / Rs 50,000 in escalating tranches at 7% interest with interest subsidy via DBT. Digital transaction cashback incentives.

schemes.name: PM MUDRA Yojana
schemes.text: PM MUDRA Yojana: Collateral-free loans for non-farm micro-enterprises. Three products: Shishu (up to Rs 50,000), Kishore (Rs 50,001 to Rs 5 lakh), Tarun (Rs 5,00,001 to Rs 10 lakh). Interest varies by bank; no government subsidy but no processing fee for Shishu.

schemes.name: Stand Up India
schemes.text: Stand Up India: Bank loans between Rs 10 lakh and Rs 1 crore for SC/ST and women entrepreneurs for greenfield enterprises in manufacturing, services, trading or agri-allied sectors. Composite loan includes working capital. Handholding support via SIDBI portal.
